Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.03666

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2024).
source_name: Gang Zhang, Weiling Yang and Xian'an Jin, “Isolation partitions in graphs”, arXiv:2411.03666 (2024).
statement: A **cycle isolating set** of a graph is a vertex set whose closed neighborhood leaves no cycle. **The planar cycle-isolation partition conjecture.** Every connected planar graph, except $C_3$, can be partitioned into four disjoint cycle isolating sets. This is proposed as a planar version of the preceding cycle-isolation partition conjecture; the paper gives no resolution.
title: The planar cycle-isolation partition conjecture
